note: Triennial election of Limavady Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. The Unionist attempt to regain the council, lost to the Nationalists in 1952, failed in the three marginal divisions. Five contests were held, including Drum. The other eighteen divisions were filled unopposed at nomination (Derry Journal, 19 May 1961, p. 10). Returned unopposed.
